common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original, refined romi server-monitoring web application prototype, grounded in the supplied official Omarchy theme preview. This is a deliberate reset from colorful generic dashboards. The reference is ONLY for spacing, extremely simple rectangular pane outlines, understated editor-like typography and palette. Do NOT reproduce its wallpaper, desktop, terminal commands, file manager, operating-system chrome, or personal text. This must be a modern usable WEB APPLICATION with readable Chinese labels, not a fake terminal.
Hard visual contract: almost entirely flat neutral theme background; hairline 1px dividers and 1–2px selected borders; SQUARE corners (0–2px maximum); NO shadows, gradients, glass, glow, grain, photographic/plant/mountain imagery, thick colored header bands, giant rounded cards, or tall colored sidebar. NO circular gauges. Brand is only a small lowercase "romi" wordmark. Use a 40–48px tall compact top navigation with unfilled text tabs and a 1px active underline. Section headings are modest 15–18px, metrics 20–26px, not poster typography. Use JetBrains Mono-like tabular digits / technical labels with clean Noto Sans SC Chinese body text. Tight but comfortable, rigorous alignment, generous whitespace BETWEEN sections, data-dense WITHIN sections. Small 2px resource bars or segmented hairlines, precise charts, fine gridlines. At least 90% of screen is background/neutral surface, accent colors only on thin lines, short text, selected controls and small status marks.
Product boundary: show host resources, upload/download SPEED in MB/s and TRAFFIC in GB/TB; labels/tags and batch settings; multi-host resource history; notifications for resource load, traffic and expiration. Absolutely NO TCP/ICMP/Ping/latency probes, HTTP tests, certificate monitoring, NODE GROUPS, service monitors, remote terminal or command execution. Tags such as #web and #backup are flat metadata, NEVER a hierarchical group sidebar. All numbers and fictional nodes are demonstration data; tiny footer says "设计原型 · 示例数据". Do not include real IPs, passwords or tokens. Mask credentials. Single clear screen or the explicitly requested administration sheet; no marketing banner or decorative promotional copy. Render at largest native resolution with crisp detailed controls.
light: THEME: Flexoki Light, sampled exactly from installed Omarchy: background #FFFCF0, secondary surface #F2EFE4, primary text #100F0F, secondary text #403E3C, inactive hairline #B7B5AC, selection #CECDC3. Accent #205EA6 only for active underline, selected border and small action text. Supporting chart lines #879A39, #3AA99F, #D0772B, and a very small error semantic #D14D41. It should feel like clean warm paper rendered digitally, NOT yellow parchment or terracotta branding. No large colored fills.
dark: Recolor the FIRST provided image into Hackerman Dark while preserving the EXACT page geometry, every table, row, graph, control, label and information hierarchy. SECOND image is the installed Omarchy Hackerman preview for palette/line treatment ONLY. Same romi product, not a different design. Background #0B0C16, secondary surface #151828, text #DDF7FF, secondary text #B5C5DB, divider #2D3450, selection #1F253A. Accent #82FB9C only on active underlines, selected outlines, tiny markers and primary action text. Distinct chart series use #82FB9C, #829DD4 and #7CF8F7. No colored header/sidebar blocks, NO gradients, bloom, glow, sci-fi HUD, grunge or wallpaper. Panels are flat, outlined with fine lines; square corners. A tiny #D14D41 error marker is a semantic exception, never a decorative fill. Maintain readable contrast. Keep all fictional data and Chinese copy identical to the light image. Header theme label may change from 'Flexoki Light' to 'Hackerman'. Do not add any panels or features.

scenes.title: 主机总览
scenes.composition:
Landscape approximately 16:10, one full application viewport, NOT a collage. Header small 'romi', unfilled top tabs '主机' (active) / '历史' and right '管理' plus 'Flexoki Light'. No left sidebar. Below header one slim baseline summary row separated with fine vertical rules: '节点 6', '在线 5', '离线 1', '上传 26.8 MB/s', '下载 144.2 MB/s', '本月流量 2.1 TB'. Each statistic is plain typography, not its own floating card.
Below: an outlined search input '搜索名称或标签', tiny outlined tag filters '#web' '#backup', status selector '全部状态' and two density icons. Main area a single rectangular fine-lined table: checkbox, 节点, 状态, 标签, CPU, 内存, 磁盘, 上传, 下载, 本月流量. Six rows SG-01, JP-02, DE-03, US-04, FR-05, UK-06. First five online, UK-06 offline with em-dashes for unknown readings. CPU 14%,22%,8%,19%,9%; memory 46%,58%,37%,52%,33%. Meter segments are short and thin. Upload MB/s values 4.2,1.8,8.4,3.2,9.2; download 24.1,18.6,31.8,28.2,41.5. Clear text labels and line-based hierarchy, no pill soup.
At bottom two simple rectangular panes: a wider '实时网速 · 最近30分钟' chart with labeled upload/download lines, and narrower '资源概览' with CPU/内存/磁盘 averages and small thin horizontal indicators. A short non-filled selection bar '已选 3 台 · 对比历史 · 清除选择' under the table demonstrates the comparison flow. Only those features. Tiny footer '最后上报 2 秒前'. No public IP addresses.

scenes.title: 历史与多节点对比
scenes.composition:
Landscape approximately 16:10, one full application viewport, NOT collage. Same minimal top header 'romi', text tabs '主机 / 历史' with 历史 underlined, right '管理' and 'Flexoki Light'. No side navigation.
A compact single-line toolbar: '历史对比', three removable thin-outline node tokens 'SG-01' 'JP-02' 'DE-03'; '过去6小时' / '自定义时间' controls, time range '2026-09-17 12:00 — 18:00', text toggle '叠加 | 并排', and '统一时间轴'. Selected states are lines/text, not broad solid fills.
Most of the canvas is six sharply bordered panes in a 2-column x 3-row grid: 'CPU 使用率 %', '内存使用率 %', '磁盘使用率 %', '上传速率 MB/s', '下载速率 MB/s', '累计流量 GB'. Each pane has three thin identifiable series with consistent color per node and different line styles when helpful. Last cumulative-traffic graph rises monotonically; no latency graph. Small horizontal axis 12:00/14:00/16:00/18:00 on ALL plots. Fine almost-invisible grid, no filled area gradients. Each title is inset into top border like a restrained btop pane label. Legends are concise and labels legible; separate percentages, rate and cumulative volume correctly.
A slim footer shows comparison metrics such as 'SG-01 平均CPU 14% / JP-02 22% / DE-03 8%' and '缺失数据 —'. No card-based KPI hero, no map, no groups, no service availability score.

scenes.title: 资产、通知与管理细节
scenes.composition:
Portrait approximately 4:5 or 3:4, a precision product UI specification sheet using the SAME romi flat web app language, with six comfortably readable rectangular detail panes in a 2-column x 3-row grid. A very small top header 'romi / 管理细节 / Flexoki Light'. Unlike a tiny 12-screen atlas, these are LARGE UI component sections with real controls; no repeated sidebars. Every pane uses fine borders, modest inline titles and little to no filled background difference.
Pane 1 '资产与批量设置': four node rows with square checkboxes, flat #web/#backup tags, private/public text, cost and expiration; selection bar '已选 3 台' and actions '添加标签 / 批量通知 / 可见性'. Slim adjacent inline form '标签 #web #backup' and '默认私有', outlined '应用到3台'. Absolutely no node grouping.
Pane 2 '通知规则': three compact editable rows '负载 · CPU使用率 >85% · 持续5分钟', '流量 · 本月用量 ≥80%', '到期 · 剩余 ≤7天'; switches with square/simple styling and 'Telegram / Webhook'. Existing offline/recovery reminder appears as one small secondary checkbox. No latency/HTTP/SSL rules.
Pane 3 '通知记录': timeline/table with 时间, 节点, 类型, 投递结果; sample CPU负载 / 流量 / 到期 entries marked 已发送 or 失败 using icon plus text; small '重试' and '静默1小时' controls. No big incident banner.
Pane 4 '安全与凭证': GitHub OAuth configured line, session list with '当前会话' and '撤销'; a one-time node token panel containing only masked '••••••••', '仅本次显示', '复制运行命令', '换发需确认'. No visible invented command or real password.
Pane 5 '数据维护': compact SQLite size, retention field '30 天', '下载备份 / 从备份恢复 / 清理过期数据', fine destructive outline with brief confirmation.
Pane 6 '设置与登录': appearance text choices 'Flexoki Light / Hackerman / 跟随系统', public-page switch OFF, country-lookup OFF, site name romi; a compact neutral login form with password field and GitHub action. No third-party theme marketplace and no system desktop reproduction.
